feature.title: The whole journey, from discovery onward.
feature.intro: Histae organises every stage of a connection: profile, compatibility, reciprocal choice, conversation, continuation, safety and data control.

profile.title: A profile that goes beyond a picture
profile.text: First name, age, bio and personality traits help people introduce themselves. The feed does not expose an exact birth date or profile photo.

preferences.title: Preferences checked both ways
preferences.text: Age ranges, who each person is looking for and maximum distance are applied mutually. A profile appears only when both sets of criteria are compatible.

location.title: Location that is consensual and temporary
location.text: Discovery requires a recent position and dedicated consent. The position becomes stale after one hour and is deleted after 24 hours without an update.

discovery.title: Clear, contextual discovery
discovery.text: Every suggestion shows useful information, traits and a rounded distance. Profiles already assessed, blocked or already matched are excluded.

stableDecisions.title: Stable decisions
stableDecisions.text: A like or pass is recorded as a stable choice for its retention period. Retrying the same decision is fine; changing it afterwards is not.

reciprocity.title: A match created only by reciprocity
reciprocity.text: Nobody is notified of an isolated like. A match exists only after both people have chosen each other.

conversationWindow.title: 24 hours to start talking
conversationWindow.text: When a match is created, a first 24-hour window opens messaging without immediately exposing photos.

continuationWindow.title: Another 24 hours to choose what comes next
continuationWindow.text: At expiry, a second 24-hour window lets each person choose whether to continue. Two agreements confirm the match.

photoReveal.title: Independent mutual photo reveal
photoReveal.text: Each person can consent to reveal. Photos appear only after two agreements, separately from the decision to continue.

messaging.title: Messaging tied to the match
messaging.text: Messages are timestamped, limited to 2,000 characters and marked read only by the recipient. An expired match accepts no new message.

safety.title: A clear framework for meeting better.
safety.intro: Trust comes from understandable rules, practical protections and ways to act directly from your account.

passwordless.title: Passwordless access
passwordless.text: Sessions start with a one-time code sent to the phone. Sessions rotate and attempts are limited to reduce abuse.

consents.title: Separate consent choices
consents.text: Terms, the privacy notice, sensitive data and location are presented separately. No marketing choice is added to the journey.

consentWithdrawal.title: Withdrawing consent has a real effect
consentWithdrawal.text: Withdrawing sensitive-data consent removes the relevant sex and preference data. Withdrawing location consent immediately removes stored presence.

rights.title: Exercise data rights from the account
rights.text: Access, portability, rectification, restriction, objection and erasure each have a dedicated, trackable journey.

about.title: We believe connections deserve time.
about.intro: Histae starts from a simple idea: a dating app can encourage curiosity without reducing people to a stream of instant choices.

promise.title: A modest promise
promise.text: We do not decide for people. We design the rules that make a connection more conscious and reciprocal.

product.title: A concrete product foundation
product.text: Profiles, mutual preferences, feed, reciprocal likes, timed matches, messaging, consent and safety tools already shape the product.

privacy.title: Privacy built into how it works
privacy.text: Sensitive data, location, rights and erasure are not afterthoughts: they determine what the product can display and process.

community.title: A space to improve together
community.text: A community’s quality depends on its members, and on tools that let them set their own boundaries.

download.title: Histae is coming soon.
download.intro: The iOS and Android app is being prepared. Download links will be published here when the launch opens.

availability.title: No pretend button
availability.text: We would rather announce real availability than send you to an empty page.

finalization.title: What we are finalising
finalization.text: The mobile apps, store publication, launch operations and future commercial journey still need to be completed and validated.

officialLinks.title: Availability announced here
officialLinks.text: This page will become the official path to the App Store and Google Play versions when they open.
